name: wheel
note: Cartoon road wheel: a ring tyre with its bore along X (a side-mounted wheel rolls about X, so the vehicle's length runs along Z and its left/right axis is X — the axis V9 mirrors about) plus a box hub filling that bore. dims = [width, diameter, diameter]. DEVIATION (M5): the brief writes dims as [diameter, width, diameter] and the tyre as a child of the hub. Both are inverted here, for one reason each. (1) dims: with the bore along X the wheel occupies `width` in x and `diameter` in y and z; [diameter, width, diameter] would be a wheel lying flat, whose axle points up. (2) root: the attach solver places the ROOT sub-part on the parent point, so the root's box must BE the composite's declared box — a hub-rooted wheel would hang its tyre half a hub above wherever it was attached. The hub is still what the wheel attaches 'through': it sits dead centre, `embedded` in the tyre, and hubFrac is set so its corners bite into the bore wall rather than floating inside it. M6: per-instance children are the default, so a mirrored or repeated wheel now gets a hub on every tyre instead of only the anchor — that is what closed the cart.json MVP-STUB, and it needed no edit here.
